findings.finding: The power governor (hifi_gov.c) at HEAD let the input pass the USB-C contract. (1) It took its gain from the clip-capped power, so on core at 20 V (0 dBFS 25.8 Vpk vs 19.0 V clip) the input was 104.4 W against a 65 W contract (1.61x), while its own estimate said 58.5 W. Lite at 15 V: 60.6 W against 45 W. (2) Its 1 s window let a 0 dBFS 45 Hz drop after quiet music run 1.39-1.64x over the contract for 507-597 ms: 9-21 J against 0.08-0.43 J of PVDD bulk. FIXED in the working tree; confirmed.
findings.evidence: docs/review-3/sims/system/run_gov.sh (gov_burst.c linked with the real hifi_gov.c): FAIL at HEAD ac484b1; PASS on the working tree: steady at or under 0.9x the contract, worst burst 1.08x for 5 ms on core at 65 W
findings.reference_design: PD sources' overload capability is optional (PD 3.x PDO peak-current bits, 1.1-1.5x for ms); commercial PD amps (Fosi/Aiyima) cut out on bass at volume
findings.fix: Applied: limiter on the unclipped power, tau_s 0.05 s, attack_s 0.01 s (plus R3-POWER-3's peak limit). Bring-up: 0 dBFS 45 Hz drop on a 65 W charger while scoping VBUS.
findings.margin: after the fix: core 20 V/65 W steady 58.4 W (10 % under the contract); burst 1.08x for 5 ms, 0.027 J against 0.163 J of bulk

findings.finding: Firmware duty L1 (Lite 13 W/ch over 30 s into 4 ohm, or the TPA3118 latches its 150 C OTP) was not implemented: hifi_gov_cfg_lite set no thermal_out_w (0 = no limit). At HEAD, -3 dBFS held 20.2 W/ch indefinitely. FIXED in the working tree (thermal_out_w 26 W, tau 30 s); confirmed: 13.1 W/ch steady. Residue: the 30 s exponential lets 20.2 W/ch (1.55x) through for the first ~31 s.
findings.evidence: docs/review-3/sims/system/thermal_lite.c: FAIL at HEAD (20.2 W/ch), PASS on the working tree (last 30 s 13.1 W/ch; highest 30 s window 20.2 W)
findings.fix: Applied. Optional: thermal_tau_s 10 s if the thermal reviewer finds the first-30 s overshoot matters.
findings.margin: steady 13.1 W vs 13 W (+0.8 %); Lite DJ direct 6.8 W/ch at FLX4 2.1 Vrms = 52 % of L1 (no limit needed)

findings.finding: Duty C1 (P05/PHY_RST low before a restart) is not in the firmware: esp_restart() is called from restart_cb, hifi_net.c (OTA) and the panic path with P05 high, and there is no shutdown handler. A brown-out (+3V3 under 2.43 V but above the TCA9539 POR) or an RTC-watchdog reset does not move EN but does re-read the straps. The 50 MHz oscillator then drives GPIO0 at the strap read, and the ESP32 can boot into ROM download mode: the box is silent and off the network until it is unplugged.
findings.evidence: fw_duties.py C1 FAIL; board_core.c has no esp_register_shutdown_handler; sdkconfig BROWNOUT_DET_LVL_SEL_0; blocks_mcu.py: Y2 OE = PHY_RST from TCA9539 P05, TCA9539 ~RESET = ESP_EN
findings.reference_design: Espressif ESP32 hardware design guidelines: use a reset supervisor on EN when the supply can ramp slowly or dip; LAN8720 + ESP32 boards (WT32-ETH01, Olimex) gate the oscillator from a GPIO for this reason
findings.fix: Firmware: esp_register_shutdown_handler() in board_core.c that writes port 0 with P05, P03, P00 and P01 low before every restart. Hardware: an open-drain 2.9-3.0 V supervisor (APX803S-29 / TPS3839 class, SOT-23; LCSC at fix time) from +3V3 on ESP_EN beside C32, so any dip resets the ESP32 and the TCA9539 together (R45 holds OE low). If there is no room: a DNP footprint.
findings.margin: none today: one brown-out with PHY_RST high is enough

findings.finding: DJ direct (FLX4) bypasses every thermal limit, and OTW is never acted on (C2's '-3 dB every 2 s' is missing; EXP_AMP_OTW is read only in the self-test; ISENSE feeds nothing). FLX4 at 2.1 Vrms gives 11.6 Vrms at the speaker, 33.6 W/ch sine into 4 ohm. DJ program (crest 8-10 dB) averages 6.7-10.6 W/ch, against Ultra's 4.4 W/ch budget (1.5-2.4x) and Plus's 9.6 W/ch (0.7-1.1x). That leads to OTE, a latched FAULT, retries, and after 3 in 60 s the amps latch off mid-set.
findings.evidence: fw_duties.py C2-OTW FAIL; board_core.c hifi_bsp_route (DJ_DIRECT only flips the switch); docs/firmware.md 'Not covered'; level from R3-AUDIO-12; budgets from firmware-requirements C2 / hifi_gov.c
findings.reference_design: TPA3220 OTW_CLIP is meant as the pre-shutdown warning (SLASEN3B); WiiM/Arylic route line in through the DSP
findings.fix: Firmware: (1) the governed path (ES7243E, I2S RX, DSP, DAC) as the default line-in route, which is also R3-AUDIO-3's fix; DJ direct opt-in. (2) In DJ direct, a 60 s average of ISENSE x VBUS against the C2 budget / 0.88 (Ultra one zone ~14 W in, Plus ~26 W); above it, or OTW low >200 ms, switch out of DJ direct with the amps held in RESET. (3) OTW step-down in the digital path.
findings.margin: Ultra -1.8 to -3.8 dB short of its budget at 4 ohm with DJ program; Plus 0.4 dB under to 0.6 dB over

findings.finding: Pop duties not implemented. L4 (Lite): SDZ goes high 600 ms after PG, whatever the codec's state. The ES8388 is set up only when squeezelite's output starts (after Wi-Fi on first set-up). Its 1.65 V VMID ramp (tau ~0.25 s) through C60 1 uF into 30 kohm gives ~0.15 V at the amp input, ~3 V peak subsonic at the speaker, at every cold start. C5 (core, also AUDIO-9): the DJ_DIRECT switch flips with the amps running: a ~0.8 V step, a click at each Input press.
findings.evidence: fw_duties.py L4 and C5 FAIL; hifi_power.c settle 200 + soft start 400 ms; TPA3118 Zi 30 kohm at 26 dB (SLOS708G table 1); HPF/ramp calc y = 1.65 x 30/220 x (e^-0.29 - e^-2.41) = 0.148 V x 19.95
findings.reference_design: TI SLOS708G sec 'pop and click': unmute the amp after the source has settled
findings.fix: L4: gate amp_on on a codec-ready flag set when codec_apply() succeeds, plus 2.5 s. C5: on an input change, AMP_A/B_RST low, 20 ms, DJ_DIRECT, release both in one write.
findings.margin: 3 V peak at 3-5 Hz into 6 ohm (1.5 W peak): no damage

findings.finding: Plus plays L on zone A (J6) and R on zone B (J11), but both chips play both channels, so J7/J10 are live. Wiring the pair to J6+J7 (zone A's own L/R) puts both channels on one chip, twice what the split's 19 W limit assumes. Plus's right speaker tap (R136/R137) is on A_SPK_R+ (J7), which is unloaded on Plus, so the 'spk_r+' loopback measures nothing the person hears.
findings.evidence: core.net: /A_SPK_R+ = C235, J7, L4, R136, R236; /amp_b/B_SPK_R+ has no tap; hifi_board_core.h HIFI_SPLIT comment
findings.fix: Binding-post task: on Plus fit/wire only the J6 and J11 posts, marked L/R; silk J7/J10 'Ultra only'. Firmware: report the loopback as L only on Plus.
findings.margin: a mis-wired Plus runs one chip at 2x its thermal budget

findings.finding: The sub-out RCA is the weakest ESD path. Lite: centre pin, 100R, 10 uF (a short at ESD speeds), ES8388 LOUT2/ROUT2. An 8 kV contact pulse (IEC 61000-4-2, 150 pF/330 ohm) puts ~19 A peak into the codec's pin diodes. Core sub out: 470R + 1 nF, ~10 A; line ins: 15k (0.5 A), 4.7k (1.6 A).
findings.evidence: root.py R36/R38 100R, C47/C48 10 uF; blocks_audio.py R92/R93 470R; calc 8 kV / (330 + 100) ohm
findings.fix: A bidirectional 5 V ~10 pF TVS (PESD5V0S1BB class, SOD-523) from SUB_L/SUB_R to GND at J3; bidirectional because the signal swings ±1.4 V about 0 V. Or R36/R38 470R (340 kHz with 1 nF of cable).
findings.margin: codec HBM rating, not a system ESD rating, is all that protects it

findings.finding: hifi_ch224_request() writes VREQ 20/28 V on any PD contract without reading the source's capabilities (CH224Q 0x60-0x8F), and only once. On a laptop's 5 V-only port at bring-up, the CH224Q's answer to an unoffered request isn't documented: a Hard-Reset loop would reboot the board every few seconds. An EPR charger with a non-EPR cable never gets 28 V and gets no fall-back to 20 V.
findings.evidence: firmware/components/hifi/core/hifi_pd.c hifi_ch224_request; board_core.c vreq_sent; WCH CH224 datasheet V2.0 sec 5.2.3 (0x60-0x8F SRCCAP, CH224Q only); known-unknowns power:5
findings.reference_design: WCH reference uses the Rset request only; PD sinks pick from Source_Capabilities
findings.fix: Read SRCCAP, request only an offered fixed PDO (28, else 20, else 15 V), retry 20 V if EPR isn't active 2 s after asking for 28 V, and take the contract V/I from that PDO (with R3-POWER-4/5).
findings.margin: unknown until a 5 V laptop and a non-EPR cable are tried at bring-up

findings.finding: The input (DJ direct) isn't saved: hifi_main.c starts at HIFI_INPUT_STREAM. Any charger blip, OTA reboot or crash in a DJ set brings the box back with the FLX4 silent until someone presses Input.
findings.evidence: fw_duties.py 'input saved' FAIL; hifi_main.c static input = HIFI_INPUT_STREAM, op_set_input/toggle_input don't call config_set_value
findings.fix: Save 'hifi_input' to NVS on change; restore it in hifi_init (core: release the amps only after the switch is set, C5).

findings.finding: Bring-up on a laptop: 5 V only, so PVDD stays off by PG and the amp can't be tested on the console; Lite +5V ≈ VBUS-0.3 V at 100 % duty (TPS54302 UVLO falling 3.6 V), core 4.35-4.6 V (POWER-13). Test the amp on a charger through the API over Wi-Fi.
Volume at boot: NVS volume (default 30), capped by max_volume (default 100); a source may push 100 %. Suggest a first-boot max_volume of 80.
Ethernet: HR911105A magnetics 1500 Vrms with integral Bob-Smith termination, shield on GND, no line-side TVS: usual for consumer gear. Accepted.
IR: IRM-3638T AGC + 100R/4.7 uF supply filter; NEC by RMT; check under a dimmed LED lamp at bring-up.
Wi-Fi in the PETG box: core keep-out on all layers, E gap 2 mm; Lite side clearance 2.5 mm (DIGITAL-18; WROVER-IE contingency). Read RSSI in the closed box.
Immune: speaker shorts (OC latch, 1 s retry, latch after 3 in 60 s) and update bricking (two OTA slots, factory recovery, rollback, 120 s trial judge).
